question: Does the existing fixed specialist endpoint's corner-P1 proxy omit material midside displacement-gradient information on the already accepted geometry subset?
decision: After the one-CAD input-only continuous-query geometry gate passed all15 checks, run one frozen-field diagnostic. No optimizer, model construction, inference, new field downloads, validation/final/dia access or automatic new loss/training.

fixed_scope.selection: Exactly the previous geometry gate rows; no target/geometry ranking, skip, replacement or expansion

geometry.access: Read vertices as sourcefloat32, verify identity, promote toFP64. No H5cells/faces/nodal_variables.

connectivity.excluded: All reference strain/volume/inverse/record members; no load_gradient_cache.

endpoint.access: Existing immutable aligned physical signed uXYZ truth and prediction. Read only this TRAIN/ver endpoint; no checkpoint or other case. NPZ members materialize179316x3 but all numerical gradient processing uses the selected320 cell-node incidences only.

normalization.cache_reproduction: Require exact float32(vertices-origin)/L reproduction of endpoint xyz and inherited canonical hash.

mathematics.quadratic_gradient: D=dN/d(r,s,t) [10,3]; J=X^T D [physical,reference]; G2=(u^T D)J^-1, compute transpose solve rather than explicit inverse; epsilon2=sym(G2), unitsdimensionless
mathematics.physical_affine_extension: u_aff(X_a)=u0+G1(X_a-X0); delta_a=u_a-u_aff(X_a), all4corner delta zero. epsilon_mid=sym((delta^T D)J^-1). Require epsilon2=epsilon1+epsilon_mid for truth and prediction.
mathematics.fixed_quadrature: 4 positive symmetric tetrahedron points: a=(5+3sqrt(5))/20, b=(5-sqrt(5))/20, each barycentric permutation of(a,b,b,b); reference weight1/24 each. w=abs(det J)/24 in mm^3. Exact polynomial energy for affine geometry/P2 displacement; only a fixed quadrature proxy for curved isoparametric geometry.
mathematics.energy: Frobenius tensor inner product xx/yy/zz plus2*(xy/xz/yz). Error e1=eps1_pred-eps1_true; emid=epsmid_pred-epsmid_true; e2=e1+emid. E2=sum w||e2||F^2=E1+Emid+2sum w<e1,emid>F. Preserve signedcross, no abs or omission.
readouts: Selected-subset quadrature-weighted reference/error RMS and relativeL2 separately for P1 and P2-u-derived proxy; do not replace historical all-node recovered P1
Truth/prediction midside residual displacement RMS; E1/Emid/signedcross/E2 and identity residual
GT-proxy mismatch epsilon2_true-epsilon1_true weighted energy/RMS and ratio to sameP2 reference; truth and prediction reference energy denominator separately
Original selectedcorner volume and quadrature volume as different diagnostics, no exact curved-volume claim
mathematics.zero_denominators: If exact reference energy is zero report ratio/relativeL2 null with explicit reason; no artificial floors, epsilon clipping or label transform.

gates.source_and_scope_identity: Strict file/source hashes, schemas, TRAIN membership, signed physical units, node/GRID-aligned coordinate identity; corrupt/exception is failed
gates.new_Gauss_J: All128 J/L finite with abs(det)>1e-18,sigma_min>1e-12,condition<1e12; sign agrees with prior regular cell orientation. One invalid point yields completed scientific negative, no cell skipping or target report from partial coverage.
gates.error_definition: Direct block maxabs(A-B)/max(1,maxabsB); energy identity abs(E2-E1-Emid-cross)/sum(abs(E2),abs(E1),abs(Emid),abs(cross)), zeroall ->0.
gates.gate_pass_meaning: Correct source/scope/numerical geometry and decomposition only. No accuracy threshold or positive utility/gen claim; high or low P2 error is a scientific observation.

Same midpointspike plusaffine ux=s: Eaff=1/12,Emid=8/15,signedcross=-1/6,Efull=9/20; catches transpose/shear2/signedcross errors
